Each member pays the same deposit once and checks in on every day they move. Every check-in needs a signature from the attester (the app's server), which signs that the wallet moved enough that day: check-ins are attested, not proven. All check-ins fill one bar. Once the bar reaches its goal before the deadline, anyone can launch the token through Flap: sponsor money plus a fixed part of the deposits (see liquidityBps) seeds the pool with half the supply, and Flap burns the LP. The rest of the deposits (the prize), the other half of the supply and 80% of the trading tax go to a StreakVault, shared among members in proportion to the days each one checked in; 20% of the tax is burned. Members with no check-in receive nothing. Sponsors, the creator and the attester receive nothing. The attester cannot launch the token, cannot stop a launch once the bar is full and cannot move funds; if it stops signing, the bar never fills and everyone takes their money back after the deadline. If the token has not launched by the deadline, every member takes the full deposit back and every sponsor their contribution."}
